transcript_class: CAPTURE-TIME VERBATIM RECORD — paste of the Overview expanded, with its source cards
d: PROVSTORE, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'ProvStore most commonly refers to the Open Provenance Model / W3C PROV Public Repository, an online public provenance repository designed to store, browse, visualize, and manage data provenance documents using W3C standards via a web interface or REST API.' Then two local businesses with map panels: PROV Tokyo, a skate and streetwear shop in Shibuya (3.8, 50 reviews, 'Closed'), and the PROV Exam Bookstore in Sandy, Utah (4.2, 1.2K, 'Open'). The closing question offers the three. Six cards: the OpenProvenance page ('ProvStore is coming back soon'), PROV Exam, ePrints Soton and the ACM Digital Library (the paper), the PROV online store, a Google place listing.
reading: The innocent reading first. The name is shared, and the Overview gives the research repository first and then two businesses called PROV, asking which is meant.
findings: THE LIFECYCLE UNSAID. The record: 'Updated 12-Sep-2026 : ProvStore was retired in December 2024', from the maintainer's page. The composition describes the repository in the present tense, and its first card is the OpenProvenance landing page that still says 'ProvStore is coming back soon'. The record's negative tag is 'a live landing page is not a live repository'; the composition follows the landing page. Checked 2026-10-29 against the provenance census record of the same day and the sources it saved.

'OPEN PROVENANCE MODEL / W3C PROV'. The Open Provenance Model is the community model that preceded W3C PROV; ProvStore's paper calls it 'the first online public provenance repository supporting the new PROV standards by W3C' (cards 3 and 4). The composition joins predecessor and standard into one name for the repository.

THE HOMONYMS. PROV Tokyo and PROV Exam share the four letters PROV and no relation to the repository; the composition gives them with map panels, ratings and hours, equal in layout to the research entity. The record is to carry them as negative tags.
THE MAINTAINER UNNAMED. Dong Huynh and King's College London are in the record; the answer names no one.
analysis: A retired provenance repository is composed as a live one: the composition takes the entity's state from the page that misstates it, and the dated retirement on the maintainer's page does not reach it. The state of the entity is the provenance fact the record exists to keep, and it is the one the composition drops.
per_note: No person or institution named (W3C only as the standard); no identifier; OpenProvenance and the paper cited.
